STYLE
Photorealistic live-action television drama footage, real optics and natural imperfections. Clear coverage, readable emotion, family-audience warmth.

LIGHTING

All speech is in Sinhala, spoken naturally by a native speaker, exactly as written — not translated, not accented English. The setting, casting and everyday details are Sri Lankan. Rendering constraints: Clean, unmarked frame — no watermarks, no captions, no subtitles, no UI overlay. Text the description spells out (on a screen, a sign, a letter or a page) is rendered exactly as written; no other lettering is invented. Anatomy stays natural and consistent: hands with five fingers, stable facial features, limbs that hold their proportions through the move. Solid objects — furniture, walls, props — are impenetrable: people move around them, never through them, and every contact carries natural weight. Objects stay put unless someone deliberately moves them. Gravity behaves normally and the camera move stays smooth and singular.
